rationale: Hold, with the horizon extended a week: nothing already planned changes in substance. Week 1 (19-25 Oct, race week for Stroud) is firm; the only edits are warm-up and chest guidance on the 21 Oct reps and the shakeout, after the 17 Oct cold-air tightness, plus a clearer 4-rep gate. 26 Oct-1 Nov stays as already provisional. New: 2-8 Nov, the first November build week: ~62 km, a 12 km Tuesday, first 18 km long run, no quality session, since volume and intensity should not rise together. Both quality sessions this week were exactly on pace but at RPE 8, and last week came to ~65 km, over October's range, so no extra volume before Stroud.

changes.notes: Rest. Race week opens with the normal Monday.

Last sharpener, 4 days before Stroud: 3km warm-up with 3-4 short pickups (cold air can trigger the chest, as on 17 Oct; a buff over the mouth until you start), 6x600m at 3:32-3:36/km with 2 min jog, 3km cool-down, ~11.5km all in. Purpose: speed just above 10K pace so race effort feels controlled. Run on pace, not under. Log any chest symptoms in the note. Nothing heavy in the gym after today. Gate: HRV still in the low 30s without a reason on the morning, or any chest tightness that lingers = 4 reps; a temperature or aches = easy run instead.
Easy 7km. No heavy leg work from today.

Shakeout 30-35 min, easy, no strides. Check Puma Fast-R Nitro 3 and kit; Symbicort 20 min and salbutamol 15 min before the gun in the morning. Warm up properly with a few pickups, buff until the start.

STROUD 10K. ~16km all in: 3km warm-up with strides, 10K, 3km cool-down. Projection 37:20 flat, course cost ~15-25 s, target ~37:30, sub-38 the floor. Pacing is in the fixture notes: short downhill first km, do not follow the faster runner, expect the back-half drag and uphill finish. Puma Fast-R Nitro 3, nothing new on the day.
Provisional — Rest. Day after Guy Fawkes.
Provisional — Easy 12km, genuinely easy; the longer Tuesday medium-long starts here at the bottom of its 18-20km range. Judge it on how the legs feel after the race, not on pace.
Provisional — Easy 8km. Leg gym back in (calf, soleus, single-leg, RDL) if the legs feel normal.
Provisional — Easy 8km. Second leg session on or after today.
Provisional — Easy 10km + 4 strides. No tempo this week: volume rises, so intensity does not. Saturday tempo returns the week after.

Provisional — Long run 18km, easy (~5:00/km or slower), the start of the Nov 18-22km progression. Gel at ~20 min and again at ~60 min (first gut-training step; log what you took). No pace work. Only if achilles 0 with no prodrome and HRV/RHR steady.
